_comment: Local flight-controller model map.
This file ships EMPTY on purpose. An unknown board is not guessed at: it
drops to SAFE MODE (read-only analysis, no PID/filter writes) and its
measured capabilities are recorded in model-map.local.json next to the
user data, so the next connection starts better informed.
Entries are keyed by BOARD IDENTIFIER (the 4-character id from
MSP_BOARD_INFO, e.g. the 'S405' in 'Board S405'). Only add an entry once
you have verified it against real hardware; a wrong entry removes a real
safety net. Set verified=true only after confirming on the bench.
Because entries here are trusted, every field is optional but the more
you fill in, the more the analysis engine can pre-empt:
name           human-readable board name
target         Betaflight build target
mcu            MCU family, e.g. STM32F405
gyro           gyro part, e.g. ICM42688P
gyroRateHz     gyro sample rate (8000 | 4000 | 3200)
defaultLoop    '8k/8k' | '4k/4k' | '2k/2k'
flashMB        onboard blackbox flash size in MiB (0 if none)
notes          free text surfaced in the UI
knownIssues    array of strings surfaced as warnings
verified       boolean - true only after bench confirmation
